messages:
cami: Hey team, noticed a canary spike on EU edge — streaming sessions are silently stalling when clients suppress empty keepalive pings. No close, no resume token in runtime traces, but billing shows duplicate token charges :thinking:

rahul: repro steps?

cami: Repro: internal websocket client lib coalesces empty pongs -> sends nothing for ~20s. Proxy/edge parks the conn, runtime marks session parked but resume_token is empty. Client reconnects, resume fails, and billing counts active tokens twice. Seen on prod-edge-v2 canary.

tim: paste logs/snippet?

cami: logs:
```
[proxy] 2026-03-20T14:02:12Z conn=abcd idle=20s action=park
[runtime] 2026-03-20T14:02:12Z session=abcd state=parked resume_token= (empty)
[billing] 2026-03-20T14:02:13Z session=abcd charge=active_tokens+=1
[client] reconnect -> new_session=efgh resume_id=abcd
[runtime] 2026-03-20T14:02:13Z resume failed=missing_token
```

cami: Also reproduces on SSE path when proxy strips empty ping event frames.

rahul: Hmm. Proxy TTL/park logic expects either resume_token or persistent lease. If token is empty we should have a fallback path. Which canary variant is it?

cami: prod-edge-v2 proxy, traffic weight ~7% canary. Client flag `suppress_keepalive=true` (ws-client 0.4.2). Repro locally with `--suppress-keepalive`.

sre-bot: @oncall alert triggered: streaming-orphan-1xx spike at 14:03 UTC (https://console/redwood/alerts/streaming-orphan-1xx)

rahul: Short-term mitigation: if session parked and resume_token is empty, set a synthetic token derived from lease id so resume becomes idempotent. Long-term: ensure proxy forwards empty ping frames instead of stripping them.

tim: Billing issue: double-charge happens because billing increments on park and increments again on new_session when resume fails. We should dedupe by session fingerprint or lease id.

cami: Quick low-risk patch: change billing increment window to use `lease_id` and only increment once per lease for a short TTL. Minimal change in billing service, behind a flag. Concern: race with shard failover.

rahul: Safer immediate action: flip canary routing rule to exclude clients with suppress_keepalive or pause the rollout until a patch.

tim: Also need telemetry and dashboard: new metrics `stream.parked.no_resume_token` and `stream.resume.missing_resume_token.count`. Dashboard tile on routing console (region=edge-eu, route=canary-prod-edge-v2).

cami: Opening a ticket and a draft PR. Telemetry names: `stream.parked.no_resume_token` and `stream.resume.missing_resume_token.count` tags {region:edge-eu, route:canary-prod-edge-v2}.

rahul: Add alert + runbook to console: rollback canary or enable `synth_resume_token` flag.

cami: PR: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/9874 (draft) — implements synthetic token generation + telemetry behind feature flag `synth_resume_token=true`.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout infra/proxy id=rollout-20260320-7 -> 7% -> 15%

tim: Pause rollout until PR reviewed/merged? @deploy-bot can you pause?

deploy-bot: Rollout paused by @rahul (reason: streaming orphan spike). Confirmed.

cami: After merging patch and enabling flag in canary, ran 30m smoke: no orphan logs, resume attempts succeed, duplicate charge rate dropped to near zero. Will follow up with proxy fix to preserve empty pings.

rahul: Plan: 1) keep `synth_resume_token` behind flag until proxy is fixed 2) add dashboard tile & alerts 3) billing dedupe follow-up to be more robust.

tim: Please add a one-liner in the console release notes so support/sales know why we paused the canary and that billing blips were transient.

cami: Done: https://confluence.redwood/sidebar/streaming-canary-2026-03-20 (notes)

rahul: Nice work catching this. We'll schedule the proxy patch and billing followup next sprint. :thumbsup:
